steps: The new drop-through and existing event-audio starter options show exact ordinary GDScript source in Chinese, English and Japanese at 390px. Mode, path, focus, source and reachable Create/Cancel controls persist; cancelling writes nothing.
Create opens an ordinary unsaved TXT draft; Save adds exactly its source and registration while preserving all existing author files.

Manage existing behavior explicitly registers one script reference. The ordinary behavior editor adds one character binding and its sole drop_action text parameter, retains every consumer binding, and preserves focus/review in three languages. Apply changes only a draft; Save changes only the behavior JSON.

The browser-authored input script drops only its own gravity character through the supporting static one-way platform onto the solid lower floor. A second character with the same actor definition stays on the original platform. Existing publishers report two landings and one platform contact start/end, with no synthesized jump; existing animation and UUID-filtered event audio execute, including two audio play receipts. Event history remains readable at 390px in three languages.
The native support contact names the one-way platform body and instance. Its source action selects the exact platform declaration, and reopening the workbench retains the event history.

Existing landing publisher, animation subscriber and audio subscriber actions open the frozen behavior document with distinct binding property identities; exact selection is checked when the runtime supplies a source range. Observation and navigation preserve the completed job and every author file after explicit Save.
